g.text: B.Cu AC SSR V16 STUDY - NOT FOR FABRICATION

CMD LED IS NOT MAINS STATE. TREAT AS LIVE.
J1,J3 NOT HOT-PLUG. SERVICE: MAINS OFF.
F1 DOES NOT PROTECT Q1 IN A HARD SHORT
